phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C4 — Eurostat bop_iip6_q Detailed-Sector Audit

stock_MIO_EUR.use: secondary dissemination consistency diagnostic; primary precision gate uses national-currency transmission

cross_source_ECB_BPS_control.interpretation: Eurostat bop_iip6_q and the retained ECB BPS assessment agree for every common tested sector within 0.1 million in each disseminated unit.

limitations: The recovered detail is BPM6 Other-Investment F2, not yet an ESA/QSA total-F2 accounting-spine observation.

Direct S11 and S1M observations solve the BPS S1V sector-detail blocker, but do not solve functional-category differences, reserve-assets treatment, or other BPM6-versus-ESA instrument-boundary differences.
The 1 million RON S11+S1M versus S1V residual is compatible with the declared integer-million national-currency publication precision and is retained explicitly rather than forced to zero.

next_gate.name: BPM6-to-ESA F2 concept bridge
next_gate.purpose: Test sector by sector whether Eurostat/ECB external F2 can be reconciled to QSA F2/F2M definitions, including reserve-assets F2 for BNR and any remaining functional-category or instrument-boundary differences.
mandatory_checks: compare external BPM6 F2 position by RMD sector against materialized QSA W1 F2M deposits; a definitionally comparable total F2 cannot be below its deposits component
identify and add reserve-assets currency-and-deposits for BNR before comparing central-bank external F2 with QSA
document any BPM6/ESA deposit-versus-loan classification differences rather than balancing them away
reconcile the sum of sector-level bridge values to total QSA W1 F2 and W1 F21 controls
no negative implied F21 value may be accepted as a currency position; such a result indicates concept mismatch or source inconsistency
no benchmark or behavioural-closure promotion until the concept bridge passes
